# Figures

FL-DEMO-IDF-003 (§9) supplies no figures. By attorney instruction, the figure set and part numerals are taken from the EP2110298B1 description (answer to IQ-1, paragraph [0017]). The drawing sheets are to be prepared from that source; FlowLeap does not generate figures. Part names follow the claim terms of the draft: the "first head" and "second head" of EP2110298B1 are the first head portion 108 and the second head portion 110; the stem portion of lever 112 is the shaft 146.
